title.zh: Cobo Wallet宣布将于12月1日关闭服务，用户需提前转出资产
title.en: Cobo Wallet宣布将于12月1日关闭服务，用户需提前转出资产

current_state.zh: Cobo Wallet announced its app service will shut down on December 1, 2026, requiring users to withdraw all assets and update associated receiving addresses and withdrawal whitelists by November 30, after which remaining balances incur a 2% monthly account management fee (minimum $100 equivalent) deemed accepted by users who fail to move funds.
